_about: Expected result of validate_delivery for each synthetic fixture, written before the code (skill test-data). line = line number in the file, header = 1. fatal = the whole delivery is stopped (schema drift); quarantine = only that line is set aside.

cases.why: Clean delivery with the edge cases of the profile: anonymous order (empty customer_id), Cancelled with total 0, Refunded, a time in the spring DST gap (2025-03-30 01:30) and one in the autumn repeated hour (2025-10-26 01:30). Bronze keeps all of them as text.
Line 3 has a byte that is not ASCII (0xFF).
A new column (channel_code) is a change of the contract: the delivery stops.
Second delivery with drift: order_status renamed to order_state. The schema check must stop it.
ORD900001 twice in one delivery: the first is kept, the second set aside.
order_status is required by the contract.
The contract says every delivery has rows (rowCount > 0).

orphans.why: A child row before its parent: OI9000009 points to ORD999999, which is not in the orders.
